basic_info.description: Sweet surprises await you in this exquisite 1940s-era bungalow nestled in the Glen Park/Fairmount Heights neighborhood. The home features two bedrooms and two bathrooms. On the ground level, is a spacious bonus suite perfect for a home office or media room. Two moods prevail throughout the house: the front-facing rooms enjoy parkside views of lush trees and greenery, while the back-facing rooms take in glorious views of SF Bay and cityscapes. Two generously proportioned rebuilt decks are perfect for sun gazing, al-fresco dining, yoga stretches, and your morning coffee. Superbly maintained and adored by its current owner, the home has a long list of improvements made over time. They include a solar system and roof replacement. Retreat to the comfort of the backyard oasis. The private and low-maintenance yard was professionally landscaped in 2021 and features a lovely aquatic pond. Glen Park is the place to be if you want to experience a bit of old San Francisco. The Village is a stone’s throw away. It has a warm & welcoming vibe and offers an exciting variety of restaurants, cafés, local artisans. Enjoy scenic trails Glen Canyon Park. Glen Park BART, Muni, express buses, bike lanes, and freeway proximity render this one of SF's most transit sensible neighborhoods
